purpose: Define the next independent live study after v0.10 without changing Cairn semantics or tuning the existing synthetic fixtures.
architectural_boundary: TerminalWorld plus the existing reference coding-agent loop
one clean checkpoint before each U/R/C branch
no framework integrations, external effects, or OpenTelemetry

task_selection.source: pinned external open-source repositories or independently authored stateful terminal tasks
required_properties: one independently verifiable work unit per continuation step
the verifier is hidden from the agent and deterministic
a capable agent cannot complete all units in one opaque mutation
task text and verifier are frozen before model execution
calibration and holdout tasks are disjoint
forbidden: editing a task or prompt after observing a failure
selecting tasks because they improve the Cairn score
counting a failed U branch as a recovery failure
using the blinded holdout for calibration

acquisition_calibration.objective: Measure whether each pinned model/provider can reach and verify a clean checkpoint.
evidence: checkpoint id and digest when eligible

continuity_evaluation.objective: Measure R and C only on U-eligible records from the frozen task tranche.

blinded_holdout.objective: Confirm the pre-registered continuity result on disjoint tasks.
blinded_holdout.entry: Only after acquisition and continuity gates pass independently.

matrix.prompt: Existing reference prompt; no post-hoc composition changes
matrix.state: Existing ContinuationState and RGR; no schema correction admitted by v0.10
matrix.verification: Existing hidden verifier plus recorded final artifact digest

integrity.raw_records: Retain every attempt, including provider, acquisition, and branch failures
integrity.selection: One deterministic record per registered cell; replacements require preserved original and explicit reason
integrity.analysis: Use acquisition/continuity stratification before any contract claim
integrity.holdout: Do not read or execute until both gates pass
